name: Beniiro Mizuumi no Ouji
source:
Elven parents and children spend their days quietly in remote villages. But angry people burst in, burn houses and kidnap women. This is a story of an elven girl who is trained daily in the port quarter to become a prostitute.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
精灵父母与孩子在偏远村庄中安静生活。然而，愤怒的人们闯入村庄，焚烧房屋并绑架女性。这是一个精灵女孩每天接受训练、最终在港口街区成为妓女的故事。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
